subject: gk
question: Kuldeep Handoo has won the Dronacharya Award in 2020. He belongs to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wushu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National wushu team coach Kuldeep Handoo is the first person from India’s Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir to receive the prestigious Dronacharya Award.
 
• Mr Handoo is serving as Inspector in Jammu and Kashmir Police Department.
 
• In his career spanning over 25 years, Kuldeep Handoo has won 11 gold medals at the national level and six at the international stage.
 
• In Dec 2020 Kuldeep Handoo was appointed Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s ‘Fit India’ Ambassador.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• List of other Dronacharya Awardee in 2020:

 
 
• Dharmendra Tiwary (Archery).
 
• Purushotham Rai (Athletics).
 
• Shiv Singh (Boxing).
 
• Romesh Pathania (Hockey).
 
• Krishan Kumar Hooda (Kabaddi).
 
• Vijay Bhalchandra Munishwar (Para Powerlifting).
 
• Naresh Kumar (Tennis).
 
• Om Parkash Dahiya (Wrestling)
